note: Layers are square transparent PNGs on one shared canvas (authored at 2000x2000, shipped at 1000x1000), so they stack with no offsets. Draw in list order, first = bottom. An accessory layer must be a square transparent PNG drawn on the same canvas; it is inserted at a slot: 'after' = directly above the named layer, 'before' = directly below it. Do not trim layers. Source: Erika's layered Canva PDF, 2026-11-11. display_box = [x, y, size] square on the 1000px canvas that frames the figure for the app's avatar tiles (the layers are not trimmed).

clothing_torso.note: shirts, scarves, bow ties; stays under the face and arms

face.note: glasses, masks; above the eyes, brows, teeth and mustache

clothing_lower.note: dress skirt, top and sash: drawn over the arms, as in the dressed art

shoes_front.note: a boot drawn in front of the skirt hem

monocle.note: monocle lens: above the eyes, under the teeth and mustache (the chain uses the face slot, over the mustache)
